errors.evidence: The slices are not ordered by size. The slice sizes are 39.2%, 38.9%, and 21.9%. The clockwise order starting from the top is 21.9%, 38.9%, 39.2%, which is from smallest to largest, not largest to smallest.
The description fails to mention that the legend includes the absolute numerical counts for each category (e.g., Null (549,238)), which is a key piece of information provided on the chart.
